title: Taurari Goma Sha Ɗaya Da Suka Yi Ruku'u
intro: An bai wa wani mutum daga Alqur'ani wahayi mai zurfi a lokacin ƙuruciya - mafarkin halittun sama suna rusunawa cikin girmamawa. Shekaru za su shuɗe ta hanyar cin amana, rabuwa, zarge-zargen ƙarya, da ɗaurin kurkuku kafin wannan wahayi ya zama gaskiya. Wanene wannan rai mai juriya wanda labarinsa ya mamaye mafi tsawon sura a cikin Alqur'ani?
clues: Na taɓa yin ƙarami, na yi mafarki mai ban mamaki wanda har mahaifina ya gargaɗe ni da in ɓoye sirrina.
'Yan'uwana, waɗanda kishi ya makantar da su, sun yi min makirci suka jefa ni cikin wani babban rijiya mai duhu.
An kai ni ƙasa mai nisa aka sayar da ni a gidan wani babban jami'i, inda na sami tagomashi kuma na hau kan mulki.
Zargin ƙarya ya kai ga ɗaure ni ba bisa ƙa'ida ba, duk da haka a cikin wannan duhun wuri na sami nutsuwa ta hanyar addu'a da sujada ga Allah.
Allah ya albarkace ni da ikon fassara mafarkai, wanda daga ƙarshe ya kawo ni gaban mai mulkin ƙasar kuma ya ɗaga ni zuwa babban matsayi na aminci.
Bayan shekaru da yawa na rabuwa, na sake haɗuwa da iyalina ƙaunatattu, kuma burina na yarinta na taurari goma sha ɗaya, rana, da wata da ke yi mini sujada ya cika a ƙarshe.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Na sake haɗuwa da iyali bayan shekaru da rabuwa kuma na zama amintaccen minista

Gina gida mai tsarki wanda ya zama wurin tsaro ga kowa da kowa
Ya fito lafiya daga cikin wata babbar halitta bayan kwana uku
outcome.answer: Na sake haɗuwa da iyali bayan shekaru da rabuwa kuma na zama amintaccen minista

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
